 Keaton Mitchell totals 66 yards in loss Sunday 
 by Leo Sells | Chargers Correspondent | Mon, Nov 9th 2026, 11:39am EST 
 Keaton Mitchell rushed the ball seven times for 33 yards and caught 3-fo-4 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Mitchell was able to contribute well on Sunday. He totaled 66 yards on his ten touches, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, so he still didn't have a good fantasy total. He shouldn't be rostered for the foreseeable future.
